requirements.scope: Build a precise reference assistant for museum conservation technicians. Look up packing material catalogue codes and quantities from the CSV, explain packing and dispatch procedures, and flag unsupported insurance valuation requests. Cite the catalogue or dispatch note for each answer.
clarifyingQuestions: Which source supports the flagged topics?
assumptions: Unanswered intake questions use the displayed audience and tone.

chunks.text: Glassine sleeve packing: Insert one mounted print into each glassine sleeve.
Humidity card placement: Place one humidity card inside the inner lid of every archive carton.
Transit foam spacing: Leave a 30 millimeter foam buffer around each framed object.
Dispatch inspection: Two technicians must initial the condition record before sealing.
Dispatch cutoff: Sealed crates must reach the collection bay by 15:30 local time.
Linen tape use: Seal only the outer wrapping seams with linen tape.
Crate label position: Affix the handling label to the upper right face.
Seal discrepancy: Send the crate to the inspection bench if the numbered seal differs from the manifest.
